cohort: The study included 323 pregnant Emirati women, with a median age of 28.6 years, residing in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
finding: The study found no significant association between maternal dietary patterns and maternal characteristics, infant characteristics, or pregnancy/neonatal outcomes, although maternal age and pre-pregnancy weight were associated with specific neonatal outcomes (Apgar score, neonatal hospital stay, neonatal weight Z-score, neonatal complications, and NICU admission).
mod_finding: No significant association was found between dietary patterns or other maternal factors and the mode of delivery.
cross-section timing: Dietary intake was reported weekly, pre-pregnancy BMI was recorded within three months of the current pregnancy, and maternal and neonatal outcomes were assessed at birth.
